messages:
alex: Standup — kernel / batching / KV perf quick check-in
alex: What I did: landed a small kernel slot-fairness patch, ran microbatch bench (seq=128/256) across stacks, pushed a canary to stack-9.
alex: Blockers: intermittent p95 spikes that look correlated with KV eviction on cold misses. I have a short repro and logs below.
alex: Repro snippet:
```
./bench --model=redwood-xl --seq=256 --concurrency=8 --trace
# watch for p95 jump around iteration ~400-600 and evict_count++ events
```
alex: Today: pair with Maya & Jun to add more granular eviction logging, try smaller max_batch_size, and test alternative packing heuristic.
maya: saw a similar p95 bump in staging yesterday night. I pulled logs; quick extract: `evict_count++ on read_miss` followed by a ~120ms spike.
jun: I can add per-shard kv-hit histograms in the canary and run an overnight sweep. Also will try reducing max_batch_size 64 -> 48 to see impact on latency tail.
sam: quick Q — does the fairness patch change slot preemption semantics? could interact with packing & batching.
alex: it reduces average hold time on a slot by ~10%, but doesn't introduce preemption. still, scheduling timing shifts might expose hot-slot churn.
maya: +1 on running with and without the patch in identical benches, will compare diffs.
infra-bot: canary deployed to stack-9 at 1768012400 by infra-bot :rocket: (manifest: kernel:v2.14.1-canary)
jun: starting bench runs now (will post aggregates). I'll do two sweeps: baseline (no fairness patch) and with patch + batch_size=48. ETA ~3h.
alex: if you see eviction spikes co-occur with GC or background compaction, flag it. that was a root cause in a prior incident.
sam: ack — I'll grep for `gc pause` and `evict` pairings across the stack logs and report any overlaps.
maya: blocker resolution plan: if Jun's histograms show a single-shard hotspot we throttle/rehash; ETA EOD. If it's systemic, we need a fallback to simpler packing.
alex: FYI PR #1428 (kernel fairness) is awaiting review — @maya @sam can you take a look when free? small patch with unit tests.
maya: on my list, will review after lunch :mag:
jun: posting first-summary at 1768013400 (baseline vs patch); will include p50/p95/p99 and per-shard hit-rate.
alex: thanks all — ping here for traces; I'll add trace markers around KV eviction path in the canary so Jun's histograms line up with traces.
maya: will also run a short smoke with prefer_hot_slots=false to see if avoiding hot-slot packing helps.
sam: noted, will drop a grep summary in thread when done.
